B[(size_t)(k0 + k) + (size_t)j * ldb] : B[(size_t)j + (size_t)(k0 + k) * ldb];\n            Bs[k][j] = v;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int kk = 0; kk < TK; ++kk) {\n            double ra[4], rb[4];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a) ra[a] = As[kk][tx + 16 * a];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) rb[b] = Bs[kk][ty + 16 * b];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a)\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) acc[a][b] = fma(ra[a], rb[b], acc[a][b]);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) {\n        const int j = ty + 16 * b;\n        if (j >= N) continue;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a) {\n            const int i = tx + 16 * a;\n            if (i >= M) continue;\n            double* c = &C[(size_t)i + (size_t)j * ldc];\n            *c = (beta == 0.0) ? alpha * acc[a][b] : alpha * acc[a][b] + beta * (*c);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ntemplate <bool TA, bool TB>\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(GEMM_THREADS)\ngemmKernel(int M, int N, int K, double alpha, const double* __restrict__ A, size_t lda,\n           const double* __restrict__ B, size_t ldb, double beta, double* __restrict__ C,\n           size_t ldc) {\n    const int i0 = blockIdx.x * TM;\n    const int j0 = blockIdx.y * TN;\n    if (i0 >= M || j0 >= N) return;\n    const double* At = TA ? B + (size_t)j0 * ldb : B + j0;\n    gemmTile<TA, TB>(min(TM, M - i0), min(TN, N - j0), K, alpha, At, lda, Bt, ldb, beta,\n                     C + i0 + (size_t)j0 * ldc, ldc);\n}\n\ntemplate <bool TA, bool TB>\nstatic void gemm(cudaStream_t s, int M, int N, int K, double alpha, const double* A, size_t lda,\n                 const double* B, size_t ldb, double beta, double* C, size_t ldc) {\n    if (M <= 0 || N <= 0) return;\n    dim3 grid((M + TM - 1) / TM, (N + TN - 1) / TN);\n    gemmKernel<TA, TB><<<grid, GEMM_THREADS, 0, s>>>(M, N, K, alpha, A, lda, B, ldb, beta, C, ldc);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// Trailing update of local block columns lj in [ljs, ljs + gridDim.z):\n//   A(j0:n, j0:j0+nbj) -= P(j0:n, :) * P(j0:j0+nbj, :)^T\n// P holds the factored panel rows [pk0, n) column-major with ld = ldp, width nbk.\n// Only tiles touching the lower triangle are computed.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(GEMM_THREADS)\ntrailingUpdateKernel(double* __restrict__ Aloc, int n, int nprocs, int rank, int ljs,\n                     const double* __restrict__ P, int pk0, int ldp, int nbk) {\n    const int lj = ljs + blockIdx.z;\n    const int j0 = (rank + nprocs * lj) * NB;\n    const int nbj = min(NB, n - j0);\n    const int r0 = j0 + blockIdx.x * TM;   // first global row of this tile\n    const int c0 = blockIdx.y * TN;        // first local column of this tile\n    if (r0 >= n || c0 >= nbj) return;\n    if (r0 + TM - 1 < j0 + c0) return;     // tile strictly above the diagonal\n    double* C = Aloc + (size_t)lj * NB * n + (size_t)c0 * n + r0;\n    gemmTile<false, false>(min(TM, n - r0), min(TN, nbj - c0), nbk, -1.0, P + (r0 - pk0),\n                           (size_t)ldp, P + (j0 + c0 - pk0), (size_t)ldp, 1.0, C, (size_t)n);\n}\n\n// Packed lower-triangular index inside shared memory (column-major, NB rows).\n__device__ __forceinline__ int pidx(int i, int j) { return j * NB - (j * (j - 1)) / 2 + (i - j); }\n\n// Factor the m x m diagonal block D (ld = ldd) in place (lower part) and write the\n// inverse of the factor to Inv (NB x NB, column-major, upper part zero).\n// flag receives the first failing local diagonal index, or -1 on success.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(POTRF_THREADS)\npotrfInvKernel(double* __restrict__ D, size_t ldd, int m, double* __restrict__ Inv,\n               int* __restrict__ flag) {\n    extern __shared__ double S[];\n    __shared__ double x[NB];\n    __shared__ int fail;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n\n    for (int t = tid; t < m * m; t += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = t % m, j = t / m;\n        if (i >= j) S[pidx(i, j)] = D[(size_t)i + (size_t)j * ldd];\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) fail = -1;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Right-looking unblocked Cholesky in shared memory\n    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double v = S[pidx(j, j)];\n            if (v <= 0.0) fail = j;\n            else S[pidx(j, j)] = sqrt(v);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (fail >= 0) break;\n        const double d = S[pidx(j, j)];\n        for (int i = j + 1 + tid; i < m; i += POTRF_THREADS) S[pidx(i, j)] /= d;\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int w = m - j - 1;\n        for (int t = tid; t < w * w; t += POTRF_THREADS) {\n            const int r = t % w, cc = t / w;\n            if (r >= cc) {\n                const int i = j + 1 + r, c = j + 1 + cc;\n                S[pidx(i, c)] -= S[pidx(i, j)] * S[pidx(c, j)];\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (fail >= 0) {\n        if (tid == 0) *flag = fail;\n        return;\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) *flag = -1;\n\n    for (int t = tid; t < m * m; t += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = t % m, j = t / m;\n        if (i >= j) D[(size_t)i + (size_t)j * ldd] = S[pidx(i, j)];\n    }\n\n    // In-place inversion of the lower-triangular factor (column by column, from the right)\n    const int row_off = tid / 8, lane = tid % 8;\n    for (int j = m - 1; j >= 0; --j) {\n        if (tid == 0) S[pidx(j, j)] = 1.0 / S[pidx(j, j)];\n        for (int k = j + 1 + tid; k < m; k += POTRF_THREADS) x[k] = S[pidx(k, j)];\n        __syncthreads();\n        const double ajj = -S[pidx(j, j)];\n        const int row = j + 1 + row_off;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        if (row < m)\n            for (int k = j + 1 + lane; k <= row; k += 8) sum += S[pidx(row, k)] * x[k];\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 4, 8);\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 2, 8);\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 1, 8);\n        if (lane == 0 && row < m) S[pidx(row, j)] = ajj * sum;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int t = tid; t < NB * NB; t += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = t % NB, j = t / NB;\n        Inv[t] = (i >= j && i < m) ? S[pidx(i, j)] : 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Add diagonal dominance on a local block column (global column offset j0).\n__global__ void addDiagKernel(double* __restrict__ panel, size_t n, int j0, int nbj, double v) {\n    const int c = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (c < nbj) panel[(size_t)c * n + j0 + c] += v;\n}\n\n// Convert local block column (rows j0..n, column-major ld n) into row-major\n// (n - j0) x nbj chunk with the strictly upper part set to zero.\n__global__ void packRowMajorKernel(const double* __restrict__ panel, int n, int j0, int nbj,\n                                   double* __restrict__ out) {\n    __shared__ double tile[32][33];\n    const int rbase = j0 + blockIdx.x * 32;\n    const int cbase = blockIdx.y * 32;\n    for (int y = threadIdx.y; y < 32; y += blockDim.y) {\n        const int c = cbase + y, r = rbase + threadIdx.x;\n        if (c < nbj && r < n) tile[y][threadIdx.x] = panel[(size_t)c * n + r];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int y = threadIdx.y; y < 32; y += blockDim.y) {\n        const int r = rbase + y, c = cbase + threadIdx.x;\n        if (c < nbj && r < n)\n            out[(size_t)(r - j0) * nbj + c] = (j0 + c <= r) ? tile[threadIdx.x][y] : 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Error statistics between reconstructed and original block column.\n__global__ void errorKernel(const double* __restrict__ R, const double* __restrict__ Ao,\n                            size_t count, unsigned long long* __restrict__ out) {\n    double maxAbs = 0.0, maxRel = 0.0;\n    for (size_t t = blockIdx.x * (size_t)blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; t < count;\n         t += (size_t)gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {\n        const double error = fabs(R[t] - Ao[t]);\n        maxAbs = fmax(maxAbs, error);\n        maxRel = fmax(maxRel, error / (fabs(Ao[t]) + 1e-10));\n    }\n    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o /= 2) {\n        maxAbs = fmax(maxAbs, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, maxAbs, o));\n        maxRel = fmax(maxRel, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, maxRel, o));\n    }\n    if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0) {\n        // Non-negative doubles order like their bit patterns\n        atomicMax(&out[0], (unsigned long long)__double_as_longlong(maxAbs));\n        atomicMax(&out[1], (unsigned long long)__double_as_longlong(maxRel));\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed context\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct Dist {\n    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n    size_t n = 0;\n    int nblk = 0;              // number of block columns\n    int nloc = 0;              // number of local block columns\n    double* dA = nullptr;      // local block columns, column-major, ld = n\n    int owner(int j) const { return j % nprocs; }\n    int localIndex(int j) const { return j / nprocs; }\n    int blockWidth(int j) const { return (int)std::min<size_t>(NB, n - (size_t)j * NB); }\n    double* panel(int lj) const { return dA + (size_t)lj * NB * n; }\n    // first local block index whose global index is > k\n    int firstLocalAfter(int k) const {\n        const int t = k + 1 - rank;\n        return t <= 0 ? 0 : (t + nprocs - 1) / nprocs;\n    }\n};\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(Dist& D) {\n    const int n = (int)D.n;\n    const int P = D.nprocs;\n    const int me = D.rank;\n\n    cudaStream_t sComp, sCopy;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sComp, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sCopy, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n\n    double *dP[2], *hP[2], *dInv;\n    int *dFlag, *hFlag;\n    const size_t pcap = (size_t)n * NB + 1;\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dP[b], pcap * sizeof(double)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hP[b], pcap * sizeof(double)));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dInv, (size_t)NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dFlag, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hFlag, sizeof(int)));\n\n    cudaEvent_t evUpd[2], evH2D[2], evFact, evD2H;\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evUpd[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evH2D[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evUpd[b], sComp));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evH2D[b], sCopy));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evFact, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evD2H, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n\n    auto panelRows = [&](int k) { return n - (k * NB + D.blockWidth(k)); };\n\n    // Owner: factor block column k (already fully updated) into dP[k % 2].\n    auto factorPanel = [&](int k) {\n        const int b = k % 2;\n        const int k0 = k * NB, nbk = D.blockWidth(k);\n        const int pk0 = k0 + nbk, mp = panelRows(k);\n        double* col = D.panel(D.localIndex(k));\n        potrfInvKernel<<<1, POTRF_THREADS, POTRF_SMEM, sComp>>>(col + (size_t)k0, (size_t)n, nbk,\n                                                               dInv, dFlag);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        if (mp > 0) {\n            gemm<false, false>(sComp, mp, nbk, nbk, 1.0, col + pk0, (size_t)n, dInv, (size_t)NB,\n                               0.0, dP[b], (size_t)mp);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(col + pk0, (size_t)n * sizeof(double), dP[b],\n                                         (size_t)mp * sizeof(double), (size_t)mp * sizeof(double),\n                                         nbk, cudaMemcpyDeviceToDevice, sComp));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evFact, sComp));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sCopy, evFact, 0));\n        if (mp > 0)\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hP[b], dP[b], (size_t)mp * nbk * sizeof(double),\n                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sCopy));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hFlag, dFlag, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sCopy));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evD2H, sCopy));\n    };\n\n    // Broadcast panel k from its owner; non-owners stage it into dP[k % 2].\n    // Returns the failing global diagonal index or -1.\n    auto sharePanel = [&](int k) -> long {\n        const int b = k % 2;\n        const int root = D.owner(k);\n        const int mp = panelRows(k), nbk = D.blockWidth(k);\n        const size_t cnt = (size_t)mp * nbk;\n        if (root == me) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(evD2H));\n            hP[b][cnt] = (double)(*hFlag);\n        } else {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(evH2D[b]));   // host buffer free again\n        }\n        if (P > 1) MPI_Bcast(hP[b], (int)(cnt + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        const long f = (long)hP[b][cnt];\n        if (f >= 0) return (long)k * NB + f;\n        if (root != me) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sCopy, evUpd[b], 0));   // device buffer free again\n            if (cnt > 0)\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dP[b], hP[b], cnt * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, sCopy));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evH2D[b], sCopy));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sComp, evH2D[b], 0));\n        }\n        return -1;\n    };\n\n    auto update = [&](int k, int ljs, int lje) {\n        const int nz = lje - ljs;\n        const int mp = panelRows(k);\n        if (nz <= 0 || mp <= 0) return;\n        const int pk0 = n - mp;\n        dim3 grid((mp + TM - 1) / TM, (NB + TN - 1) / TN, nz);\n        trailingUpdateKernel<<<grid, GEMM_THREADS, 0, sComp>>>(D.dA, n, P, me, ljs, dP[k % 2], pk0,\n                                                               mp, D.blockWidth(k));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    };\n\n    long failed = -1;\n    if (D.nblk > 0) {\n        if (D.owner(0) == me) factorPanel(0);\n        failed = sharePanel(0);\n    }\n    for (int k = 0; k < D.nblk && failed < 0; ++k) {\n        int ljs = D.firstLocalAfter(k);\n        const bool look = (k + 1 < D.nblk) && D.owner(k + 1) == me;\n        if (look) {\n            // Lookahead: bring block column k+1 up to date and factor it first\n            update(k, ljs, ljs + 1);\n            factorPanel(k + 1);\n            ++ljs;\n        }\n        update(k, ljs, D.nloc);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evUpd[k % 2], sComp));\n        if (k + 1 < D.nblk) failed = sharePanel(k + 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n\n    if (failed >= 0 && me == 0)\n        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %ld\\n\", failed);\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dP[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hP[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evUpd[b]));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evH2D[b]));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evFact));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evD2H));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dInv));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dFlag));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hFlag));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(sComp));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(sCopy));\n    return failed < 0;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (local block columns only)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(Dist& D) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    const size_t n = D.n;\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (sequential random stream, identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    double* dB;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, std::max<size_t>(1, n * n) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B.data(), n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T for the owned block columns: A(i, j) = sum_k B[i][k] * B[j][k]\n    for (int lj = 0; lj < D.nloc; ++lj) {\n        const int j = D.rank + D.nprocs * lj;\n        const int j0 = j * NB, nbj = D.blockWidth(j);\n        gemm<true, true>(0, (int)n, nbj, (int)n, 1.0, dB, n, dB + (size_t)j0 * n, n, 0.0,\n                         D.panel(lj), n);\n        // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n        addDiagKernel<<<(nbj + 127) / 128, 128>>>(D.panel(lj), n, j0, nbj, (double)n);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dB));\n}\n\n// Gather the factor as a row-major n x n matrix (upper part zero) on rank 0.\nvoid gatherResult(const Dist& D, std::vector<double>& A, double* dPack, double* hPack,\n                  const std::vector<long long>& rankCount) {\n    const size_t n = D.n;\n    size_t off = 0;\n    for (int lj = 0; lj < D.nloc; ++lj) {\n        const int j = D.rank + D.nprocs * lj;\n        const int j0 = j * NB, nbj = D.blockWidth(j);\n        dim3 grid((unsigned)((n - j0 + 31) / 32), (nbj + 31) / 32);\n        packRowMajorKernel<<<grid, dim3(32, 8)>>>(D.panel(lj), (int)n, j0, nbj, dPack + off);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        off += (n - j0) * nbj;\n    }\n    if (off > 0) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hPack, dPack, off * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(D.nprocs), displs(D.nprocs);\n    long long tot = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < D.nprocs; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = (int)rankCount[r];\n        displs[r] = (int)tot;\n        tot += rankCount[r];\n    }\n    std::vector<double> G;\n    if (D.rank == 0) G.resize(std::max<long long>(1, tot));\n    if (D.nprocs > 1) {\n        MPI_Gatherv(hPack, (int)off, MPI_DOUBLE, G.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                    0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    } else if (off > 0) {\n        memcpy(G.data(), hPack, off * sizeof(double));\n    }\n    if (D.rank != 0) return;\n\n    // Offsets of every global block column inside G\n    std::vector<size_t> src(D.nblk);\n    std::vector<size_t> pos(displs.begin(), displs.end());\n    for (int j = 0; j < D.nblk; ++j) {\n        const int r = D.owner(j);\n        src[j] = pos[r];\n        pos[r] += (n - (size_t)j * NB) * D.blockWidth(j);\n    }\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (size_t i = 0; Because A is symmetric, block\n// column j of A equals block row j of the row-major input.\n//\n// Algorithm: right-looking blocked Cholesky with one step of lookahead.\n//   for each block column k:\n//     owner: factor the diagonal block and invert the factor (one kernel), then solve\n//            the panel L_ik = A_ik * L_kk^-T as a GEMM with the inverse. The finished\n//            block column (rows k0..n) is stored row-major, which is exactly the layout\n//            of the final result.\n//     the block column is sent to all ranks in pipelined chunks\n//            (device -> pinned host -> MPI -> pinned host -> device).\n//     all:   trailing update A_ij -= L_ik * L_jk^T on the owned block columns (GEMM).\n// The owner of block column k+1 updates and factors it first, so its transfer overlaps\n// the remaining trailing update of step k. Pointers are already offset to the tile.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ntemplate <bool TA, bool TB>\n__device__ __forceinline__ void gemmTile(int M, int N, int K, double alpha,\n                                         const double* __restrict__ A, size_t lda,\n                                         const double* __restrict__ B, size_t ldb,\n                                         double beta, double* __restrict__ C, size_t ldc) {\n    __shared__ double As[TK][TM + 1];\n    __shared__ double Bs[TK][TN + 1];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int tx = tid % 16;\n    const int ty = tid / 16;\n\n    double acc[4][4];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) acc[a][b] = 0.0;\n\n    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += TK) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int q = 0; q < (TM * TK) / GEMM_THREADS; ++q) {\n            const int e = tid + q * GEMM_THREADS;\n            int i, k;\n            if (TA) { i = e / TK; k = e % TK; } else { i = e % TM; k = e / TM; }\n            double v = 0.0;\n            if (i < M && k0 + k < K)\n                v = TA ? }\n\n// Factor the m x m diagonal block D (column-major, ld = ldd, lower part used).\n// Writes the factor row-major (m x m, upper part zero) to Out and the inverse of the\n// factor to Inv (NB x NB, column-major, upper part zero).\n// flag receives the first failing local diagonal index, or -1 on success.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(POTRF_THREADS)\npotrfInvKernel(const double* __restrict__ D, size_t ldd, int m, double* __restrict__ Out,\n               double* __restrict__ Inv, int* __restrict__ flag) {\n    extern __shared__ double S[];\n    __shared__ double x[NB];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int rowOff = tid / 8, lane = tid % 8;   // 8 threads cooperate on one row\n\n    for (int t = tid; t < m * m; t += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = t % m, j = t / m;\n        if (i >= j) S[pidx(i, j)] = D[(size_t)i + (size_t)j * ldd];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Left-looking Cholesky: column j from the already finished columns 0..j-1\n    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n        const int row = j + rowOff;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        if (row < m)\n            for (int k = lane; k < j; k += 8) sum += S[pidx(row, k)] * S[pidx(j, k)];\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 4, 8);\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 2, 8);\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 1, 8);\n        if (lane == 0 && row < m) x[row] = S[pidx(row, j)] - sum;\n        __syncthreads();\n        const double val = x[j];\n        if (val <= 0.0) {   // uniform across the block\n            if (tid == 0) *flag = j;\n            return;\n        }\n        const double d = sqrt(val);\n        if (lane == 0 && row < m) S[pidx(row, j)] = (row == j) ? d : x[row] / d;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) *flag = -1;\n\n    for (int t = tid; t < m * m; t += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = t / m, j = t % m;\n        Out[t] = (j <= i) ? S[pidx(i, j)] : 0.0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // In-place inversion of the lower-triangular factor (column by column, from the right)\n    for (int j = m - 1; j >= 0; --j) {\n        const double ajj = -1.0 / S[pidx(j, j)];\n        for (int k = j + 1 + tid; k < m; k += POTRF_THREADS) x[k] = S[pidx(k, j)];\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int row = j + 1 + rowOff;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        if (row < m)\n            for (int k = j + 1 + lane; k <= row; k += 8) sum += S[pidx(row, k)] * x[k];\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 4, 8);\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 2, 8);\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 1, 8);\n        if (lane == 0 && row < m) S[pidx(row, j)] = ajj * sum;\n        if (tid == 0) S[pidx(j, j)] = -ajj;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int t = tid; t < NB * NB; t += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = t % NB, j = t / NB;\n        Inv[t] = (i >= j && i < m) ? S[pidx(i, j)] : 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Add diagonal dominance on a local block column (global column offset j0).\n__global__ void addDiagKernel(double* __restrict__ panel, size_t n, int j0, int nbj, double v) {\n    const int c = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (c < nbj) panel[(size_t)c * n + j0 + c] += v;\n}\n\n// Error statistics between reconstructed and original block column.\n__global__ void errorKernel(const double* __restrict__ R, const double* __restrict__ Ao,\n                            size_t count, unsigned long long* __restrict__ out) {\n    double maxAbs = 0.0, maxRel = 0.0;\n    for (size_t t = blockIdx.x * (size_t)blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; t < count;\n         t += (size_t)gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {\n        const double error = fabs(R[t] - Ao[t]);\n        maxAbs = fmax(maxAbs, error);\n        maxRel = fmax(maxRel, error / (fabs(Ao[t]) + 1e-10));\n    }\n    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o /= 2) {\n        maxAbs = fmax(maxAbs, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, maxAbs, o));\n        maxRel = fmax(maxRel, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, maxRel, o));\n    }\n    if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0) {\n        // Non-negative doubles order like their bit patterns\n        atomicMax(&out[0], (unsigned long long)__double_as_longlong(maxAbs));\n        atomicMax(&out[1], (unsigned long long)__double_as_longlong(maxRel));\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed context and workspace\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct Dist {\n    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n    size_t n = 0;\n    int nblk = 0;              // number of block columns\n    int nloc = 0;              // number of local block columns\n    double* dA = nullptr;      // local block columns, column-major, ld = n\n\n    // Rank 0: every finished block column k (rows k*NB..n, row-major) at hRes + resOff[k]\n    double* hRes = nullptr;\n    std::vector<size_t> resOff;\n\n    // Workspace of the factorization\n    cudaStream_t sComp = nullptr, sCopy = nullptr;\n    double* dP[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};   // block column k on the device in dP[k % 2]\n    double* hP[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};   // pinned staging (ranks != 0)\n    double* dInv = nullptr;\n    int* dFlag = nullptr;\n    int* hFlag = nullptr;\n    cudaEvent_t evUpd[2], evH2D[2], evFact, evFlag;\n    std::vector<cudaEvent_t> evChunk;\n\n    int owner(int j) const { return j % nprocs; }\n    int localIndex(int j) const { return j / nprocs; }\n    int blockWidth(int j) const { return (int)std::min<size_t>(NB, n - (size_t)j * NB); }\n    double* panel(int lj) const { return dA + (size_t)lj * NB * n; }\n    // first local block index whose global index is > k\n    int firstLocalAfter(int k) const {\n        const int t = k + 1 - rank;\n        return t <= 0 ? 0 : (t + nprocs - 1) / nprocs;\n    }\n    // host buffer holding block column k on this rank\n    double* hostPanel(int k) const { return rank == 0 ? hRes + resOff[k] : hP[k % 2]; }\n\n    void allocWork() {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sComp, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sCopy, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n        const size_t cap = std::max<size_t>(1, n * NB);\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dP[b], cap * sizeof(double)));\n            if (rank != 0) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hP[b], cap * sizeof(double)));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evUpd[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evH2D[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evUpd[b], sComp));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evH2D[b], sCopy));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dInv, (size_t)NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dFlag, sizeof(int)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hFlag, sizeof(int)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evFact, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evFlag, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        evChunk.resize((n + CHUNK_ROWS - 1) / CHUNK_ROWS + 1);\n        for (auto& e : evChunk) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&e, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n\n    void freeWork() {\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dP[b]));\n            if (hP[b]) CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hP[b]));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evUpd[b]));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evH2D[b]));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dInv));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dFlag));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hFlag));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evFact));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evFlag));\n        for (auto& e : evChunk) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(e));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(sComp));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(sCopy));\n    }\n};\n\n// Copy finished block column k (rows k0..n, row-major in hRes) into the row-major\n// result; rows are split among nworkers workers.\nstatic void assembleBlock(const Dist& D, std::vector<double>& A, int k, int worker, int nworkers) {\n    const size_t n = D.n;\n    const size_t k0 = (size_t)k * NB;\n    const int nbk = D.blockWidth(k);\n    const double* src = D.hRes + D.resOff[k];\n    for (size_t i = k0 + worker; i < n; i += nworkers)\n        memcpy(&A[i * n + k0], &src[(i - k0) * nbk], nbk * sizeof(double));\n}\n\n// Returns true on success. On rank 0, A receives the row-major factor (upper part zero).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(Dist& D, std::vector<double>& A) {\n    const int n = (int)D.n;\n    const int P = D.nprocs;\n    const int me = D.rank;\n    cudaStream_t sComp = D.sComp, sCopy = D.sCopy;\n\n    auto panelRows = [&](int k) { return n - k * NB; };\n    auto numChunks = [&](int k) { return (panelRows(k) + CHUNK_ROWS - 1) / CHUNK_ROWS; };\n\n    // Owner: factor block column k (already fully updated) into dP[k % 2] and start\n    // copying it to the host chunk by chunk.\n    auto factorPanel = [&](int k) {\n        const int b = k % 2;\n        const int k0 = k * NB, nbk = D.blockWidth(k);\n        const int rows = panelRows(k), mp = rows - nbk;\n        const double* col = D.panel(D.localIndex(k));\n        potrfInvKernel<<<1, POTRF_THREADS, POTRF_SMEM, sComp>>>(col + k0, (size_t)n, nbk, D.dP[b],\n                                                               D.dInv, D.dFlag);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        // L(i, :) = A(i, :) * Linv^T, written row-major below the diagonal block\n        gemm<false, false>(sComp, nbk, mp, nbk, 1.0, D.dInv, (size_t)NB, col + k0 + nbk, (size_t)n,\n                           0.0, D.dP[b] + (size_t)nbk * nbk, (size_t)nbk);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(D.evFact, sComp));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sCopy, D.evFact, 0));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(D.hFlag, D.dFlag, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sCopy));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(D.evFlag, sCopy));\n        double* h = D.hostPanel(k);\n        for (int c = 0; c < numChunks(k); ++c) {\n            const size_t r0 = (size_t)c * CHUNK_ROWS;\n            const size_t cnt = std::min<size_t>(CHUNK_ROWS, rows - r0) * nbk;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(h + r0 * nbk, D.dP[b] + r0 * nbk, cnt * sizeof(double),\n                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sCopy));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(D.evChunk[c], sCopy));\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Distribute block column k from its owner to all ranks (pipelined chunks).\n    // Returns the failing global diagonal index or -1.\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> reqs;\n    auto sharePanel = [&](int k) -> long {\n        const int b = k % 2;\n        const int root = D.owner(k);\n        const int nbk = D.blockWidth(k), rows = panelRows(k), nch = numChunks(k);\n        double* h = D.hostPanel(k);\n        int f = -1;\n        if (root == me) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(D.evFlag));\n            f = *D.hFlag;\n        }\n        if (P > 1) MPI_Bcast(&f, 1, MPI_INT, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (f >= 0) return (long)k * NB + f;\n\n        const int tag = k % 32768;\n        reqs.clear();\n        if (root == me) {\n            for (int c = 0; c < nch; ++c) {\n                const size_t r0 = (size_t)c * CHUNK_ROWS;\n                const int cnt = (int)(std::min<size_t>(CHUNK_ROWS, rows - r0) * nbk);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(D.evChunk[c]));\n                for (int d = 0; d < P; ++d) {\n                    if (d == me) continue;\n                    reqs.emplace_back();\n                    MPI_Isend(h + r0 * nbk, cnt, MPI_DOUBLE, d, tag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs.back());\n                }\n            }\n            MPI_Waitall((int)reqs.size(), reqs.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n        } else {\n            if (me != 0) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(D.evH2D[b]));   // staging buffer free\n            reqs.resize(nch);\n            for (int c = 0; c < nch; ++c) {\n                const size_t r0 = (size_t)c * CHUNK_ROWS;\n                const int cnt = (int)(std::min<size_t>(CHUNK_ROWS, rows - r0) * nbk);\n                MPI_Irecv(h + r0 * nbk, cnt, MPI_DOUBLE, root, tag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[c]);\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sCopy, D.evUpd[b], 0));       // device buffer free\n            for (int c = 0; c < nch; ++c) {\n                const size_t r0 = (size_t)c * CHUNK_ROWS;\n                const size_t cnt = std::min<size_t>(CHUNK_ROWS, rows - r0) * nbk;\n                MPI_Wait(&reqs[c], MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(D.dP[b] + r0 * nbk, h + r0 * nbk, cnt * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, sCopy));\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(D.evH2D[b], sCopy));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sComp, D.evH2D[b], 0));\n        }\n        return -1;\n    };\n\n    auto update = [&](int k, int ljs, int lje) {\n        const int nz = lje - ljs;\n        const int k0 = k * NB, nbk = D.blockWidth(k);\n        const int mp = n - k0 - nbk;\n        if (nz <= 0 || mp <= 0) return;\n        dim3 grid((mp + TM - 1) / TM, (NB + TN - 1) / TN, nz);\n        trailingUpdateKernel<<<grid, GEMM_THREADS, 0, sComp>>>(D.dA, n, P, me, ljs, D.dP[k % 2],\n                                                               k0, nbk);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    };\n\n    // Rank 0: helper threads assemble finished block columns into the row-major result\n    std::atomic<int> arrived{0};\n    std::atomic<bool> stop{false};\n    const int nthreads = (me == 0) ? std::max(2, std::min(omp_get_max_threads(), 9)) : 1;\n    long failed = -1;\n\n#pragma omp parallel num_threads(nthreads)\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            // Main thread: drives the GPU and all MPI communication\n            if (D.nblk > 0) {\n                if (D.owner(0) == me) factorPanel(0);\n                failed = sharePanel(0);\n                if (failed < 0) arrived.store(1, std::memory_order_release);\n            }\n            for (int k = 0; k < D.nblk && failed < 0; ++k) {\n                int ljs = D.firstLocalAfter(k);\n                if (k + 1 < D.nblk && D.owner(k + 1) == me) {\n                    // Lookahead: bring block column k+1 up to date and factor it first\n                    update(k, ljs, ljs + 1);\n                    factorPanel(k + 1);\n                    ++ljs;\n                }\n                update(k, ljs, D.nloc);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(D.evUpd[k % 2], sComp));\n                if (k + 1 < D.nblk) {\n                    failed = sharePanel(k + 1);\n                    if (failed < 0) arrived.store(k + 2, std::memory_order_release);\n                }\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n            stop.store(true, std::memory_order_release);\n        } else if (failed < 0) {\n            // Helper threads (rank 0 only)\n            const int w = tid - 1, nw = nthreads - 1;\n            for (int k = 0; k < D.nblk; ++k) {\n                while (arrived.load(std::memory_order_acquire) <= k) {\n                    if (stop.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&\n                        arrived.load(std::memory_order_acquire) <= k)\n                        break;\n                }\n                if (arrived.load(std::memory_order_acquire) <= k) break;\n                assembleBlock(D, A, k, w, nw);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (failed >= 0 && me == 0)\n        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %ld\\n\", failed);\n    return failed < 0;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (local block columns only)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(Dist& D) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    const size_t n = D.n;\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (sequential random stream, identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    double* dB;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, std::max<size_t>(1, n * n) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B.data(), n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T for the owned block columns: A(i, j) = sum_k B[i][k] * B[j][k]\n    for (int lj = 0; lj < D.nloc; ++lj) {\n        const int j = D.rank + D.nprocs * lj;\n        const int j0 = j * NB, nbj = D.blockWidth(j);\n        gemm<true, true>(0, (int)n, nbj, (int)n, 1.0, dB, n, dB + (size_t)j0 * n, n, 0.0,\n                         D.panel(lj), n);\n        // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n        addDiagKernel<<<(nbj + 127) / 128, 128>>>(D.panel(lj), n, j0, nbj, (double)n);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dB));\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const Dist& D, const double* dAorig) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    // (each rank checks its own block columns on its GPU)\n    const size_t n = D.n;\n    std::vector<double> Lb;\n    const double* Lp = L.data();\n    if (D.rank != 0) {\n        Lb.resize(n * n);\n        Lp = Lb.data();\n    }\n    // Broadcast L in chunks to stay within int counts\n    const size_t chunk = (size_t)1 << 28;\n    for (size_t o = 0; o < n * n; o += chunk)\n        MPI_Bcast((void*)(Lp + o), (int)std::min(chunk, n * n - o), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    double *dL, *dR;\n    unsigned long long* dErr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dL, std::max<size_t>(1, n * n) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dR, std::max<size_t>(1, n * NB) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dErr, 2 * sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dErr, 0, 2 * sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dL, Lp, n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    for (int lj = 0; lj < D.nloc; ++lj) {\n        const int j = D.rank + D.nprocs * lj;\n        const int j0 = j * NB, nbj = D.blockWidth(j);\n        // reconstructed(i, j) = sum_k L[i][k] * L[j][k]\n        gemm<true, true>(0, (int)n, nbj, (int)n, 1.0, dL, n, dL + (size_t)j0 * n, n, 0.0, dR, n);\n        errorKernel<<<512, 256>>>(dR, dAorig + (size_t)lj * NB * n, n * nbj, dErr);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    unsigned long long hErr[2];\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hErr, dErr, sizeof(hErr), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dL));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dR));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dErr));\n\n    double loc[2], glob[2];\n    memcpy(&loc[0], &hErr[0], sizeof(double));\n    memcpy(&loc[1], &hErr[1], sizeof(double));\n    MPI_Allreduce(loc, glob, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double maxError = glob[0];\n    const double relError = glob[1];\n\n    if (D.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (D.rank == 0) printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n    Dist D;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &D.rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &D.nprocs);\n    const bool root = D.rank == 0;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // One GPU per rank (round-robin over the node-local ranks)\n    {\n        MPI_Comm local;\n        MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, D.rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &local);\n        int localRank;\n        MPI_Comm_rank(local, &localRank);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&local);\n        int ndev = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&ndev));\n        if (ndev == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device found\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % ndev));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(potrfInvKernel, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,\n                                        (int)POTRF_SMEM));\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n Pointers are already offset to the tile.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ntemplate <bool TA, bool TB>\n__device__ __forceinline__ void gemmTile(int M, int N, int K, double alpha,\n                                         const double* __restrict__ A, size_t lda,\n                                         const double* __restrict__ B, size_t ldb,\n                                         double beta, double* __restrict__ C, size_t ldc) {\n    __shared__ double As[TK][TM + 1];\n    __shared__ double Bs[TK][TN + 1];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int tx = tid % 16;\n    const int ty = tid / 16;\n\n    double acc[4][4];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) acc[a][b] = 0.0;\n\n    for (int k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += TK) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int q = 0; q < (TM * TK) / GEMM_THREADS; ++q) {\n            const int e = tid + q * GEMM_THREADS;\n            int i, k;\n            if (TA) { i = e / TK; k = e % TK; } else { i = e % TM; k = e / TM; }\n            double v = 0.0;\n            if (i < M && k0 + k < K)\n                v = TA ?   // 8 threads cooperate on one row\n\n    for (int t = tid; t < m * m; t += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = t % m, j = t / m;\n        if (i >= j) S[pidx(i, j)] = D[(size_t)i + (size_t)j * ldd];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // Left-looking Cholesky: column j from the already finished columns 0..j-1\n    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n        const int row = j + rowOff;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        if (row < m)\n            for (int k = lane; k < j; k += 8) sum += S[pidx(row, k)] * S[pidx(j, k)];\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 4, 8);\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 2, 8);\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 1, 8);\n        if (lane == 0 && row < m) x[row] = S[pidx(row, j)] - sum;\n        __syncthreads();\n        const double val = x[j];\n        if (val <= 0.0) {   // uniform across the block\n            if (tid == 0) *flag = j;\n            return;\n        }\n        const double d = sqrt(val);\n        if (lane == 0 && row < m) S[pidx(row, j)] = (row == j) ? d : x[row] / d;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) *flag = -1;\n\n    for (int t = tid; t < m * m; t += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = t / m, j = t % m;\n        Out[t] = (j <= i) ? S[pidx(i, j)] : 0.0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    // In-place inversion of the lower-triangular factor (column by column, from the right)\n    for (int j = m - 1; j >= 0; --j) {\n        const double ajj = -1.0 / S[pidx(j, j)];\n        for (int k = j + 1 + tid; k < m; k += POTRF_THREADS) x[k] = S[pidx(k, j)];\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int row = j + 1 + rowOff;\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        if (row < m)\n            for (int k = j + 1 + lane; k <= row; k += 8) sum += S[pidx(row, k)] * x[k];\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 4, 8);\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 2, 8);\n        sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, 1, 8);\n        if (lane == 0 && row < m) S[pidx(row, j)] = ajj * sum;\n        if (tid == 0) S[pidx(j, j)] = -ajj;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int t = tid; t < NB * NB; t += POTRF_THREADS) {\n        const int i = t % NB, j = t / NB;\n        Inv[t] = (i >= j && i < m) ? S[pidx(i, j)] : 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Add diagonal dominance on a local block column (global column offset j0).\n__global__ void addDiagKernel(double* __restrict__ panel, size_t n, int j0, int nbj, double v) {\n    const int c = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (c < nbj) panel[(size_t)c * n + j0 + c] += v;\n}\n\n// Error statistics between reconstructed and original block column.\n__global__ void errorKernel(const double* __restrict__ R, const double* __restrict__ Ao,\n                            size_t count, unsigned long long* __restrict__ out) {\n    double maxAbs = 0.0, maxRel = 0.0;\n    for (size_t t = blockIdx.x * (size_t)blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; t < count;\n         t += (size_t)gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {\n        const double error = fabs(R[t] - Ao[t]);\n        maxAbs = fmax(maxAbs, error);\n        maxRel = fmax(maxRel, error / (fabs(Ao[t]) + 1e-10));\n    }\n    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o /= 2) {\n        maxAbs = fmax(maxAbs, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, maxAbs, o));\n        maxRel = fmax(maxRel, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, maxRel, o));\n    }\n    if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0) {\n        // Non-negative doubles order like their bit patterns\n        atomicMax(&out[0], (unsigned long long)__double_as_longlong(maxAbs));\n        atomicMax(&out[1], (unsigned long long)__double_as_longlong(maxRel));\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed context and workspace\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct Dist {\n    int rank = 0, nprocs = 1;\n    size_t n = 0;\n    int nblk = 0;              // number of block columns\n    int nloc = 0;              // number of local block columns\n    double* dA = nullptr;      // local block columns, column-major, ld = n\n\n    // Rank 0: every finished block column k (rows k*NB..n, row-major) at hRes + resOff[k]\n    double* hRes = nullptr;\n    std::vector<size_t> resOff;\n\n    // Workspace of the factorization\n    cudaStream_t sComp = nullptr, sCopy = nullptr;\n    double* dP[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};   // block column k on the device in dP[k % 2]\n    double* hP[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};   // pinned staging (ranks != 0)\n    double* dInv = nullptr;\n    int* dFlag = nullptr;\n    int* hFlag = nullptr;\n    cudaEvent_t evUpd[2], evH2D[2], evFact, evFlag;\n    std::vector<cudaEvent_t> evChunk;\n\n    int owner(int j) const { return j % nprocs; }\n    int localIndex(int j) const { return j / nprocs; }\n    int blockWidth(int j) const { return (int)std::min<size_t>(NB, n - (size_t)j * NB); }\n    double* panel(int lj) const { return dA + (size_t)lj * NB * n; }\n    // first local block index whose global index is > k\n    int firstLocalAfter(int k) const {\n        const int t = k + 1 - rank;\n        return t <= 0 ? 0 : (t + nprocs - 1) / nprocs;\n    }\n    // host buffer holding block column k on this rank\n    double* hostPanel(int k) const { return rank == 0 ? hRes + resOff[k] : hP[k % 2]; }\n\n    void allocWork() {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sComp, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sCopy, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n        const size_t cap = std::max<size_t>(1, n * NB);\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dP[b], cap * sizeof(double)));\n            if (rank != 0) CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hP[b], cap * sizeof(double)));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evUpd[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evH2D[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evUpd[b], sComp));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evH2D[b], sCopy));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dInv, (size_t)NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dFlag, sizeof(int)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hFlag, sizeof(int)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evFact, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evFlag, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        evChunk.resize((n + CHUNK_ROWS - 1) / CHUNK_ROWS + 1);\n        for (auto& e : evChunk) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&e, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n\n    void freeWork() {\n        for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dP[b]));\n            if (hP[b]) CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hP[b]));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evUpd[b]));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evH2D[b]));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dInv));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dFlag));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hFlag));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evFact));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(evFlag));\n        for (auto& e : evChunk) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(e));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(sComp));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(sCopy));\n    }\n};\n\n// Copy finished block column k (rows k0..n, row-major in hRes) into the row-major\n// result; rows are split among nworkers workers.\nstatic void assembleBlock(const Dist& D, std::vector<double>& A, int k, int worker, int nworkers) {\n    const size_t n = D.n;\n    const size_t k0 = (size_t)k * NB;\n    const int nbk = D.blockWidth(k);\n    const double* src = D.hRes + D.resOff[k];\n    for (size_t i = k0 + worker; i < n; i += nworkers)\n        memcpy(&A[i * n + k0], &src[(i - k0) * nbk], nbk * sizeof(double));\n}\n\n// Returns true on success. On rank 0, A receives the row-major factor (upper part zero).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(Dist& D, std::vector<double>& A) {\n    const int n = (int)D.n;\n    const int P = D.nprocs;\n    const int me = D.rank;\n    cudaStream_t sComp = D.sComp, sCopy = D.sCopy;\n\n    auto panelRows = [&](int k) { return n - k * NB; };\n    auto numChunks = [&](int k) { return (panelRows(k) + CHUNK_ROWS - 1) / CHUNK_ROWS; };\n\n    // Owner: factor block column k (already fully updated) into dP[k % 2] and start\n    // copying it to the host chunk by chunk.\n    auto factorPanel = [&](int k) {\n        const int b = k % 2;\n        const int k0 = k * NB, nbk = D.blockWidth(k);\n        const int rows = panelRows(k), mp = rows - nbk;\n        const double* col = D.panel(D.localIndex(k));\n        potrfInvKernel<<<1, POTRF_THREADS, POTRF_SMEM, sComp>>>(col + k0, (size_t)n, nbk, D.dP[b],\n                                                               D.dInv, D.dFlag);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        // L(i, :) = A(i, :) * Linv^T, written row-major below the diagonal block\n        gemm<false, false>(sComp, nbk, mp, nbk, 1.0, D.dInv, (size_t)NB, col + k0 + nbk, (size_t)n,\n                           0.0, D.dP[b] + (size_t)nbk * nbk, (size_t)nbk);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(D.evFact, sComp));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sCopy, D.evFact, 0));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(D.hFlag, D.dFlag, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sCopy));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(D.evFlag, sCopy));\n        double* h = D.hostPanel(k);\n        for (int c = 0; c < numChunks(k); ++c) {\n            const size_t r0 = (size_t)c * CHUNK_ROWS;\n            const size_t cnt = std::min<size_t>(CHUNK_ROWS, rows - r0) * nbk;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(h + r0 * nbk, D.dP[b] + r0 * nbk, cnt * sizeof(double),\n                                       cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sCopy));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(D.evChunk[c], sCopy));\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Distribute block column k from its owner to all ranks (pipelined chunks).\n    // Returns the failing global diagonal index or -1.\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> reqs;\n    auto sharePanel = [&](int k) -> long {\n        const int b = k % 2;\n        const int root = D.owner(k);\n        const int nbk = D.blockWidth(k), rows = panelRows(k), nch = numChunks(k);\n        double* h = D.hostPanel(k);\n        int f = -1;\n        if (root == me) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(D.evFlag));\n            f = *D.hFlag;\n        }\n        if (P > 1) MPI_Bcast(&f, 1, MPI_INT, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (f >= 0) return (long)k * NB + f;\n\n        const int tag = k % 32768;\n        reqs.clear();\n        if (root == me) {\n            for (int c = 0; c < nch; ++c) {\n                const size_t r0 = (size_t)c * CHUNK_ROWS;\n                const int cnt = (int)(std::min<size_t>(CHUNK_ROWS, rows - r0) * nbk);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(D.evChunk[c]));\n                for (int d = 0; d < P; ++d) {\n                    if (d == me) continue;\n                    reqs.emplace_back();\n                    MPI_Isend(h + r0 * nbk, cnt, MPI_DOUBLE, d, tag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs.back());\n                }\n            }\n            MPI_Waitall((int)reqs.size(), reqs.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n        } else {\n            if (me != 0) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(D.evH2D[b]));   // staging buffer free\n            reqs.resize(nch);\n            for (int c = 0; c < nch; ++c) {\n                const size_t r0 = (size_t)c * CHUNK_ROWS;\n                const int cnt = (int)(std::min<size_t>(CHUNK_ROWS, rows - r0) * nbk);\n                MPI_Irecv(h + r0 * nbk, cnt, MPI_DOUBLE, root, tag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqs[c]);\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sCopy, D.evUpd[b], 0));       // device buffer free\n            for (int c = 0; c < nch; ++c) {\n                const size_t r0 = (size_t)c * CHUNK_ROWS;\n                const size_t cnt = std::min<size_t>(CHUNK_ROWS, rows - r0) * nbk;\n                MPI_Wait(&reqs[c], MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(D.dP[b] + r0 * nbk, h + r0 * nbk, cnt * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, sCopy));\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(D.evH2D[b], sCopy));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sComp, D.evH2D[b], 0));\n        }\n        return -1;\n    };\n\n    auto update = [&](int k, int ljs, int lje) {\n        const int nz = lje - ljs;\n        const int k0 = k * NB, nbk = D.blockWidth(k);\n        const int mp = n - k0 - nbk;\n        if (nz <= 0 || mp <= 0) return;\n        dim3 grid((mp + TM - 1) / TM, (NB + TN - 1) / TN, nz);\n        trailingUpdateKernel<<<grid, GEMM_THREADS, 0, sComp>>>(D.dA, n, P, me, ljs, D.dP[k % 2],\n                                                               k0, nbk);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    };\n\n    // Rank 0: helper threads assemble finished block columns into the row-major result\n    std::atomic<int> arrived{0};\n    std::atomic<bool> stop{false};\n    const int nthreads = (me == 0) ? std::max(2, std::min(omp_get_max_threads(), 9)) : 1;\n    long failed = -1;\n\n#pragma omp parallel num_threads(nthreads)\n    {\n        const int tid = omp_get_thread_num();\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            // Main thread: drives the GPU and all MPI communication\n            if (D.nblk > 0) {\n                if (D.owner(0) == me) factorPanel(0);\n                failed = sharePanel(0);\n                if (failed < 0) arrived.store(1, std::memory_order_release);\n            }\n            for (int k = 0; k < D.nblk && failed < 0; ++k) {\n                int ljs = D.firstLocalAfter(k);\n                if (k + 1 < D.nblk && D.owner(k + 1) == me) {\n                    // Lookahead: bring block column k+1 up to date and factor it first\n                    update(k, ljs, ljs + 1);\n                    factorPanel(k + 1);\n                    ++ljs;\n                }\n                update(k, ljs, D.nloc);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(D.evUpd[k % 2], sComp));\n                if (k + 1 < D.nblk) {\n                    failed = sharePanel(k + 1);\n                    if (failed < 0) arrived.store(k + 2, std::memory_order_release);\n                }\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n            stop.store(true, std::memory_order_release);\n        } else {\n            // Helper threads (rank 0 only)\n            const int w = tid - 1, nw = nthreads - 1;\n            for (int k = 0; k < D.nblk; ++k) {\n                while (arrived.load(std::memory_order_acquire) <= k &&\n                       !stop.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {\n                }\n                if (arrived.load(std::memory_order_acquire) <= k) break;\n                assembleBlock(D, A, k, w, nw);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (failed >= 0 && me == 0)\n        printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %ld\\n\", failed);\n    return failed < 0;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (local block columns only)\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(Dist& D) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    const size_t n = D.n;\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B (sequential random stream, identical on every rank)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    double* dB;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, std::max<size_t>(1, n * n) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dB, B.data(), n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T for the owned block columns: A(i, j) = sum_k B[i][k] * B[j][k]\n    for (int lj = 0; lj < D.nloc; ++lj) {\n        const int j = D.rank + D.nprocs * lj;\n        const int j0 = j * NB, nbj = D.blockWidth(j);\n        gemm<true, true>(0, (int)n, nbj, (int)n, 1.0, dB, n, dB + (size_t)j0 * n, n, 0.0,\n                         D.panel(lj), n);\n        // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n        addDiagKernel<<<(nbj + 127) / 128, 128>>>(D.panel(lj), n, j0, nbj, (double)n);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dB));\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const Dist& D, const double* dAorig) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    // (each rank checks its own block columns on its GPU)\n    const size_t n = D.n;\n    std::vector<double> Lb;\n    const double* Lp = L.data();\n    if (D.rank != 0) {\n        Lb.resize(n * n);\n        Lp = Lb.data();\n    }\n    // Broadcast L in chunks to stay within int counts\n    const size_t chunk = (size_t)1 << 28;\n    for (size_t o = 0; o < n * n; o += chunk)\n        MPI_Bcast((void*)(Lp + o), (int)std::min(chunk, n * n - o), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    double *dL, *dR;\n    unsigned long long* dErr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dL, std::max<size_t>(1, n * n) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dR, std::max<size_t>(1, n * NB) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dErr, 2 * sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dErr, 0, 2 * sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dL, Lp, n * n * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    for (int lj = 0; lj < D.nloc; ++lj) {\n        const int j = D.rank + D.nprocs * lj;\n        const int j0 = j * NB, nbj = D.blockWidth(j);\n        // reconstructed(i, j) = sum_k L[i][k] * L[j][k]\n        gemm<true, true>(0, (int)n, nbj, (int)n, 1.0, dL, n, dL + (size_t)j0 * n, n, 0.0, dR, n);\n        errorKernel<<<512, 256>>>(dR, dAorig + (size_t)lj * NB * n, n * nbj, dErr);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    unsigned long long hErr[2];\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hErr, dErr, sizeof(hErr), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dL));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dR));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dErr));\n\n    double loc[2], glob[2];\n    memcpy(&loc[0], &hErr[0], sizeof(double));\n    memcpy(&loc[1], &hErr[1], sizeof(double));\n    MPI_Allreduce(loc, glob, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double maxError = glob[0];\n    const double relError = glob[1];\n\n    if (D.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (D.rank == 0) printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n    Dist D;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &D.rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &D.nprocs);\n    const bool root = D.rank == 0;\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // One GPU per rank (round-robin over the node-local ranks)\n    {\n        MPI_Comm MPI_Comm_free(&local);\n        int ndev = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&ndev));\n        if (ndev == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA device found\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % ndev));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(potrfInvKernel, cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,\n                                        (int)POTRF_SMEM));\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n     // world rank -> node-local rank, or -1 if remote\n324\t    std::vector<double*> slotBase;   // node-local rank -> its shared slots\n325\t    bool anyRemote = false;\n326\t\n327\t    int owner(int j) const { return j % nprocs; Small matrices (n ≤ ~4096) are limited by per-step latency and gain little from extra GPUs.\n\n## How it's split up\n- **MPI:** the matrix is divided into 128-wide block columns dealt round-robin to the ranks, one GPU per rank. It uses blocked Cholesky with one step of lookahead: the owner of the next block column factors it first, so sending it overlaps the rest of the current step's work.\n- **CUDA:** the bulk matrix-multiply updates and the panel solve run in custom GPU kernels (no cuBLAS, so nothing new to depend on). The critical-path work goes on a high-priority stream, separate from the bulk updates.\n- **CPU:** each small diagonal block is factored and inverted on the host. On the GPU it took 0.8–1.6 ms per step because these cards are very slow at double precision; on the CPU it takes about 0.2 ms.\n- **Communication:** ranks on the same node share finished columns through an MPI shared-memory window and copy them straight to their GPU. This avoids a ~3 GB/s limit in Open MPI's normal copy path and gave the biggest gain (n=8192 on 4 GPUs: 210 → 119 ms). Ranks on other nodes get the data as ordinary chunked MPI messages.\n- **OpenMP:** helper threads on rank 0 assemble the final row-major result while the factorization is still running.\n\n## Correctness\n- Output matches the original to the last one or two digits, and is identical across 1–4 ranks.\n- Validation passed for n = 1, 7, 128, 129, 256, 1000, 2500, 3000 and 4097, and with 8 ranks sharing 4 GPUs.\n- For a matrix that isn't positive definite, the program prints the original's error message with the correct element index and exits with code 1, without hanging.\n\n## Things you should know\n- **The timing is wider than the original's.** It covers the factorization plus collecting the full result on rank 0 in the original row-major layout, so the reported speedups include that cost.\n- **Matrix generation and validation also run on the GPUs.** Neither is timed. Generation gives the same matrix up to rounding (summation order differs).\n- **The multi-node path has not run on a real cluster.** I tested it with a temporary build that treated each rank, or pairs of ranks, as separate nodes. It validated and ran fast (692–731 ms at n=16384), but real multiple nodes are still untested.\n- **CMake:** it now compiles `cholesky.cpp` with nvcc. It picks `g++-12` as the host compiler when present, because CUDA 12.0 doesn't support the default GCC 13, and builds for the local GPU type. It requires MPI, OpenMP and the CUDA toolkit.\n\nTo run: `mpirun -np <#GPUs> ./cholesky -n N [-v] [-r]`.
